sanskrit: adāriś ca nadījaś ca karṇaveṣṭaś ca pārthivaḥ samarthaś ca suvīraś ca mārjāraḥ kanyakas tathā
english: Adāri and Nadīja and the king Karṇaveṣṭa, and Samartha and Suvīra and Mārjāra and likewise Kanyaka —

sanskrit: mahāvīraś ca kadruś ca nikaras tumulaḥ krathaḥ nīlaś ca vīradharmā ca bhūmipālaś ca vīryavān
english: and Mahāvīra and Kadrū, and Nikara, Tumula, Krātha, and Nīla and Vīradharman and the valiant Bhūmipāla —

sanskrit: durjayo dantavaktraś ca rukmī ca janamejayaḥ āṣāḍho vāyuvegaś ca pūrvapālī ca pārthivaḥ
english: Durjaya and Dantavaktra and Rukmī and Janamejaya, Āṣāḍha and Vāyuvega and the king Pūrvapālī —

sanskrit: bhūritejā devakaś ca ekalavyasya cātmajaḥ kārūṣakāś ca rājānaḥ kṣemadhūrtiś ca vīryavān
english: Bhūritejā and Devaka and the son of Ekalavya, the kings of Kārūṣa and the valiant Kṣemadhūrti —

sanskrit: udbhavaḥ kṣemakaś caiva vāṭadhānaś ca pārthivaḥ śrutāyuś ca dṛḍhāyuś ca śālvaputraś ca vīryavān
english: Udbhava and Kṣemaka and king Vāṭadhāna, and Śrutāyu and Dṛḍhāyu and the valiant son of Śalva —

sanskrit: kumāraś ca kaliṅgānām īśvaro yuddhadurmadaḥ eteṣāṃ preṣyatāṃ śīghram etad dhi mama rocate
english: and Kumāra, lord of the Kaliṅgas, who is maddened in battle — let swift messengers be sent to all of these; this indeed is my desire.

sanskrit: ayaṃ ca brāhmaṇaḥ śīghraṃ mama rājan purohitaḥ preṣyatāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrāya vākyam asmin samarpyatām
english: And let my own priest, this brahmin, be swiftly sent, O king, to Dhṛtarāṣṭra; let the message be entrusted to him.

sanskrit: yathā duryodhano vācyo yathā śāṃtanavo nṛpaḥ dhṛtarāṣṭro yathā vācyo droṇaś ca viduṣāṃ varaḥ
english: Let him know how Duryodhana is to be addressed, and how the son of Śaṃtanu the king, and how Dhṛtarāṣṭra is to be addressed, and Droṇa the foremost of the wise.

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca upapannam idaṃ vākyaṃ somakānāṃ dhuraṃdhare arthasiddhikaraṃ rājñaḥ pāṇḍavasya mahaujasaḥ
english: Vāsudeva said: This counsel is fitting, O foremost bearer of the Somakas' yoke — it will bring about the success of the mighty Pāṇḍava king.

sanskrit: etac ca pūrvakāryaṃ naḥ sunītam abhikāṅkṣatām anyathā hy ācaran karma puruṣaḥ syāt subāliśaḥ
english: And this is the proper first course of action for us who seek the right policy; for a man who acts otherwise in such matters would be utterly foolish.

sanskrit: kiṃ tu saṃbandhakaṃ tulyam asmākaṃ kurupāṇḍuṣu yatheṣṭaṃ vartamāneṣu pāṇḍaveṣu ca teṣu ca
english: Yet our kinship and bond is equal with both the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas, who both conduct themselves as they please.

sanskrit: te vivāhārtham ānītā vayaṃ sarve yathā bhavān kṛte vivāhe muditā gamiṣyāmo gṛhān prati
english: We were all brought here for the sake of the wedding, even as you were, O king; when the marriage is done, we shall return home joyfully.

sanskrit: bhavān vṛddhatamo rājñāṃ vayasā ca śrutena ca śiṣyavat te vayaṃ sarve bhavāmeha na saṃśayaḥ
english: You are the eldest among kings in age and in learning; we are all here as your disciples — of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit: bhavantaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca satataṃ bahu manyate ācāryayoḥ sakhā cāsi droṇasya ca kṛpasya ca
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra too holds you in constant high regard; and you are the friend of both the preceptors, of Droṇa and of Kṛpa.

sanskrit: sa bhavān preṣayatv adya pāṇḍavārthakaraṃ vacaḥ sarveṣāṃ niścitaṃ tan naḥ preṣayiṣyati yad bhavān
english: Therefore let you now send forth the word that will serve the Pāṇḍavas' cause; all of us are certain that whatever you send forth, so it shall be.

sanskrit: yadi tāvac chamaṃ kuryān nyāyena kurupuṃgavaḥ na bhavet kurupāṇḍūnāṃ saubhrātreṇa mahān kṣayaḥ
english: If the bull of the Kurus should make peace through righteous means, then the great destruction of Kurus and Pāṇḍavas as brothers will not come to pass.

sanskrit: atha darpānvito mohān na kuryād dhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ anyeṣāṃ preṣayitvā ca paścād asmān samāhvayeḥ
english: But if the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, filled with pride and delusion, should refuse, then after sending to the others, you may summon us in turn.

sanskrit: tato duryodhano mandaḥ sahāmātyaḥ sabāndhavaḥ niṣṭhām āpatsyate mūḍhaḥ kruddhe gāṇḍīvadhanvani
english: Then that dull-witted Duryodhana, foolish together with his ministers and kinsmen, will meet his end when the wielder of the Gāṇḍīva bow is enraged.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ satkṛtya vārṣṇeyaṃ virāṭaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ gṛhān prasthāpayām āsa sagaṇaṃ sahabāndhavam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Virāṭa, lord of the earth, having duly honoured the Vārṣṇeya, sent him homeward together with his retinue and kinsmen.

sanskrit: dvārakāṃ tu gate kṛṣṇe yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ cakruḥ sāṃgrāmikaṃ sarvaṃ virāṭaś ca mahīpatiḥ
english: When Kṛṣṇa had departed for Dvārakā, Yudhiṣṭhira and his brothers, along with king Virāṭa lord of the earth, made all preparations for war.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃpreṣayām āsa virāṭaḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ sarveṣāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ drupadaś ca mahīpatiḥ
english: Then Virāṭa together with his kinsmen, and king Drupada lord of the earth, sent messengers to all the rulers of the land.

sanskrit: vacanāt kurusiṃhānāṃ matsyapāñcālayoś ca te samājagmur mahīpālāḥ saṃprahṛṣṭā mahābalāḥ
english: At the word of the lion-like Kurus and of the Matsyas and Pāñcālas, those mighty lords of the earth came together, filled with joy.

sanskrit: tac chrutvā pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ samāgacchan mahad balam dhṛtarāṣṭrasutaś cāpi samāninye mahīpatīn
english: Hearing of the gathering of the sons of Pāṇḍu, a great host assembled; and the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra likewise assembled kings to his side.

sanskrit: samākulā mahī rājan kurupāṇḍavakāraṇāt tadā samabhavat kṛtsnā saṃprayāṇe mahīkṣitām
english: O king, the entire earth became filled with turmoil on account of the Kurus and Pāṇḍavas, as the lords of the earth set out on their march.

sanskrit: balāni teṣāṃ vīrāṇām āgacchanti tatas tataḥ cālayantīva gāṃ devīṃ saparvatavanām imām
english: The armies of those heroes came from every direction, shaking, as it were, this very earth, goddess adorned with mountains and forests.

sanskrit: tataḥ prajñāvayovṛddhaṃ pāñcālyaḥ svapurohitam kurubhyaḥ preṣayām āsa yudhiṣṭhiramate tadā
english: Then the king of Pāñcāla, with Yudhiṣṭhira's approval, sent his own priest — venerable in wisdom and years — to the Kurus.

sanskrit: drupada uvāca bhūtānāṃ prāṇinaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ prāṇināṃ buddhijīvinaḥ buddhimatsu narāḥ śreṣṭhā narāṇāṃ tu dvijātayaḥ
english: Drupada said: Among living beings, those that breathe are the highest; among those that breathe, the highest are those who live by intellect; among the intelligent, men are highest; and among men, the twice-born are supreme.

sanskrit: dvijeṣu vaidyāḥ śreyāṃso vaidyeṣu kṛtabuddhayaḥ sa bhavān kṛtabuddhīnāṃ pradhāna iti me matiḥ
english: Among the twice-born, those learned in the Vedas are better; and among Vedic scholars, those of perfected understanding are best. You, good sir, are the foremost among those of perfected understanding — so it is my judgment.

sanskrit: kulena ca viśiṣṭo 'si vayasā ca śrutena ca prajñayānavamaś cāsi śukreṇāṅgirasena ca
english: You are distinguished by lineage, by age, and by sacred learning; and in wisdom you are not inferior to Śukra and Aṅgiras themselves.

sanskrit: viditaṃ cāpi te sarvaṃ yathāvṛttaḥ sa kauravaḥ pāṇḍavaś ca yathāvṛttaḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: You also know fully how the Kaurava has conducted himself, and how the Pāṇḍava, Yudhiṣṭhira the son of Kuntī, has conducted himself.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭrasya vidite vañcitāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ paraiḥ vidureṇānunīto 'pi putram evānuvartate
english: With Dhṛtarāṣṭra's knowledge the Pāṇḍavas were deceived by their enemies; and even though entreated by Vidura, he only follows his son.

sanskrit: śakunir buddhipūrvaṃ hi kuntīputraṃ samāhvayat anakṣajñaṃ matākṣaḥ san kṣatravṛtte sthitaṃ śucim
english: For Śakuni, himself expert at dice, deliberately challenged the son of Kuntī — who was ignorant of dice but stood firm in the warrior's code, a man of purity.

sanskrit: te tathā vañcayitvā tu dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram na kasyāṃ cid avasthāyāṃ rājyaṃ dāsyanti vai svayam
english: Having cheated Yudhiṣṭhira the son of Dharma in that manner, they will never of their own will restore the kingdom under any circumstances.

sanskrit: bhavāṃs tu dharmasaṃyuktaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ bruvan vacaḥ manāṃsi tasya yodhānāṃ dhruvam āvartayiṣyati
english: But you, speaking righteous words to Dhṛtarāṣṭra, will certainly turn the minds of his warriors.

sanskrit: viduraś cāpi tad vākyaṃ sādhayiṣyati tāvakam bhīṣmadroṇakṛpāṇāṃ ca bhedaṃ saṃjanayiṣyati
english: And Vidura will further your message and will sow discord among Bhīṣma, Droṇa, and Kṛpa.

sanskrit: amātyeṣu ca bhinneṣu yodheṣu vimukheṣu ca punar ekāgrakaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ karma bhaviṣyati
english: And when the counsellors are divided and the warriors turned away, it will be hard work for them to reunite those forces.

sanskrit: etasminn antare pārthāḥ sukham ekāgrabuddhayaḥ senākarma kariṣyanti dravyāṇāṃ caiva saṃcayam
english: In that interval the sons of Pṛthā, with undivided attention and ease, will accomplish their military tasks and the gathering of resources.

sanskrit: bhidyamāneṣu ca sveṣu lambamāne ca vai tvayi na tathā te kariṣyanti senākarma na saṃśayaḥ
english: And while their own ranks are divided and you delay, they will not be able to carry out their military preparations with the same effect — of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit: etat prayojanaṃ cātra prādhānyenopalabhyate saṃgatyā dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca kuryād dharmyaṃ vacas tava
english: This is the chief purpose to be gained here; and through the combined effect, Dhṛtarāṣṭra may even act on your righteous counsel.

sanskrit: sa bhavān dharmayuktaś ca dharmyaṃ teṣu samācaran kṛpāluṣu parikleśān pāṇḍavānāṃ prakīrtayan
english: Therefore let you, devoted to righteousness, deal righteously with those compassionate ones, recounting to them the sufferings of the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: vṛddheṣu kuladharmaṃ ca bruvan pūrvair anuṣṭhitam vibhetsyati manāṃsy eṣām iti me nātra saṃśayaḥ
english: Speaking of the family duty as observed by the ancestors to those elders, you will divide their minds — of this I have no doubt.

sanskrit: na ca tebhyo bhayaṃ te 'sti brāhmaṇo hy asi vedavit dūtakarmaṇi yuktaś ca sthaviraś ca viśeṣataḥ
english: And you have no reason to fear them: you are a brahmin, learned in the Vedas, skilled in the office of envoy, and an elder besides.

sanskrit: sa bhavān puṣyayogena muhūrtena jayena ca kauraveyān prayātv āśu kaunteyasyārthasiddhaye
english: Therefore let you depart swiftly to the Kauravas under the auspicious lunar asterism Puṣya and in a victorious moment, for the accomplishment of the Kauteya's purpose.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tathānuśiṣṭaḥ prayayau drupadena mahātmanā purodhā vṛttasaṃpanno nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus instructed by the great-souled Drupada, the priest, a man of excellent conduct, set out for the city called the Abode of the Serpent.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca gate dvāravatīṃ kṛṣṇe baladeve ca mādhave saha vṛṣṇyandhakaiḥ sarvair bhojaiś ca śataśas tathā
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: When Kṛṣṇa the Mādhava had departed for Dvāravatī along with Baladeva and all the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas and hundreds of Bhojas as well —

sanskrit: sarvam āgamayām āsa pāṇḍavānāṃ viceṣṭitam dhṛtarāṣṭrātmajo rājā dūtaiḥ praṇihitaiś caraiḥ
english: the king, son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, had his spies and secret agents bring him full intelligence of all that the Pāṇḍavas were doing.

sanskrit: sa śrutvā mādhavaṃ yātaṃ sadaśvair anilopamaiḥ balena nātimahatā dvārakām abhyayāt purīm
english: Having heard that the Mādhava had departed with fine horses matchless as the wind, Duryodhana went with a not-too-large force to the city of Dvārakā.

sanskrit: tam eva divasaṃ cāpi kaunteyaḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ ānartanagarīṃ ramyāṃ jagāmāśu dhanaṃjayaḥ
english: On that very same day, Dhanaṃjaya the son of Kuntī, the delight of the Pāṇḍus, swiftly went to the beautiful city of Ānarta.

sanskrit: tau yātvā puruṣavyāghrau dvārakāṃ kurunandanau suptaṃ dadṛśatuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śayānaṃ copajagmatuḥ
english: Those two tiger-like men, both delights of the Kurus, went to Dvārakā and found Kṛṣṇa asleep; and they drew near as he lay resting.

sanskrit: tataḥ śayāne govinde praviveśa suyodhanaḥ ucchīrṣataś ca kṛṣṇasya niṣasāda varāsane
english: Then, while Govinda lay sleeping, Suyodhana entered and sat down on a splendid seat at Kṛṣṇa's head.

sanskrit: tataḥ kirīṭī tasyānu praviveśa mahāmanāḥ paścārdhe ca sa kṛṣṇasya prahvo 'tiṣṭhat kṛtāñjaliḥ
english: Then the diademed one, that high-minded hero, entered after him and stood humbly at Kṛṣṇa's feet, hands joined in reverence.

sanskrit: pratibuddhaḥ sa vārṣṇeyo dadarśāgre kirīṭinam sa tayoḥ svāgataṃ kṛtvā yathārhaṃ pratipūjya ca tadāgamanajaṃ hetuṃ papraccha madhusūdanaḥ
english: When the Vārṣṇeya awoke, he saw the diademed Arjuna before him; having welcomed them both fittingly and honoured them as they deserved, the Slayer of Madhu asked the reason for their coming.

sanskrit: tato duryodhanaḥ kṛṣṇam uvāca prahasann iva vigrahe 'smin bhavān sāhyaṃ mama dātum ihārhati
english: Then Duryodhana, speaking as if with a laugh, said to Kṛṣṇa: In this conflict, O noble one, it is fitting that you render assistance to me.

sanskrit: samaṃ hi bhavataḥ sakhyaṃ mayi caivārjune 'pi ca tathā saṃbandhakaṃ tulyam asmākaṃ tvayi mādhava
english: For your friendship with me and with Arjuna is equal, and likewise our kinship with you is equal on both sides, O Mādhava.

sanskrit: ahaṃ cābhigataḥ pūrvaṃ tvām adya madhusūdana pūrvaṃ cābhigataṃ santo bhajante pūrvasāriṇaḥ
english: And I have come to you first this day, O Slayer of Madhu; the good honour the one who comes first, favouring those who arrive before others.

sanskrit: tvaṃ ca śreṣṭhatamo loke satām adya janārdana satataṃ saṃmataś caiva sadvṛttam anupālaya
english: And you are today the most honoured among the righteous in the world, O Janārdana, always held in high esteem — uphold then the conduct of the good.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇa uvāca bhavān abhigataḥ pūrvam atra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ dṛṣṭas tu prathamaṃ rājan mayā pārtho dhanaṃjayaḥ
english: Kṛṣṇa said: That you came first, of this I have no doubt; but it was Pārtha Dhanaṃjaya whom I saw first upon waking, O king.

sanskrit: tava pūrvābhigamanāt pūrvaṃ cāpy asya darśanāt sāhāyyam ubhayor eva kariṣyāmi suyodhana
english: On account of your having come first, and likewise on account of his having been seen first, I shall render assistance to both of you, Suyodhana.

sanskrit: pravāraṇaṃ tu bālānāṃ pūrvaṃ kāryam iti śrutiḥ tasmāt pravāraṇaṃ pūrvam arhaḥ pārtho dhanaṃjayaḥ
english: But tradition holds that the younger should be offered first choice; therefore it is Pārtha Dhanaṃjaya who deserves to be offered first selection.

sanskrit: matsaṃhananatulyānāṃ gopānām arbudaṃ mahat nārāyaṇā iti khyātāḥ sarve saṃgrāmayodhinaḥ
english: A great host of ten crores of cowherds equal to me in bodily strength, known by the name of Nārāyaṇas — all of them battle-fighters —

sanskrit: te vā yudhi durādharṣā bhavantv ekasya sainikāḥ ayudhyamānaḥ saṃgrāme nyastaśastro 'ham ekataḥ
english: let those warriors, formidable in battle, be the soldiers of one party; while on the other side stands I alone, not fighting in the battle, my weapons laid aside.

sanskrit: ābhyām anyataraṃ pārtha yat te hṛdyataraṃ matam tad vṛṇītāṃ bhavān agre pravāryas tvaṃ hi dharmataḥ
english: O Pārtha, whichever of these two alternatives seems more pleasing to your heart, choose that first; for by right you are to be offered the first choice.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evam uktas tu kṛṣṇena kuntīputro dhanaṃjayaḥ ayudhyamānaṃ saṃgrāme varayām āsa keśavam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus addressed by Kṛṣṇa, Dhanaṃjaya the son of Kuntī chose Keśava — the one who would not fight in the battle.

sanskrit: sahasrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ tu yodhānāṃ prāpya bhārata kṛṣṇaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ jñātvā saṃprāpa paramāṃ mudam
english: O Bhārata, obtaining a thousand thousands of warriors and knowing that Kṛṣṇa was thereby taken away from him, Duryodhana reached the highest joy.

sanskrit: duryodhanas tu tat sainyaṃ sarvam ādāya pārthivaḥ tato 'bhyayād bhīmabalo rauhiṇeyaṃ mahābalam
english: Then king Duryodhana, taking all that army, went thereafter to Rauhiṇeya of tremendous might and fearsome strength.

sanskrit: sarvaṃ cāgamane hetuṃ sa tasmai saṃnyavedayat pratyuvāca tataḥ śaurir dhārtarāṣṭram idaṃ vacaḥ
english: He laid before him the full reason for his coming, and then the Śauri, the descendant of Śūra, replied to the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra with these words.

sanskrit: viditaṃ te naravyāghra sarvaṃ bhavitum arhati yan mayoktaṃ virāṭasya purā vaivāhike tadā
english: O tiger among men, all that I said formerly at the wedding ceremony of Virāṭa's daughter — all of it ought to be known to you.

sanskrit: nigṛhyokto hṛṣīkeśas tvadarthaṃ kurunandana mayā saṃbandhakaṃ tulyam iti rājan punaḥ punaḥ
english: Though the Hṛṣīkeśa was restrained and addressed on your behalf, O delight of the Kurus, by me saying again and again 'our kinship is equal,' O king —

sanskrit: na ca tad vākyam uktaṃ vai keśavaḥ pratyapadyata na cāham utsahe kṛṣṇaṃ vinā sthātum api kṣaṇam
english: yet Keśava did not accept those words when spoken; and I do not presume to stand apart from Kṛṣṇa even for a moment.

sanskrit: nāhaṃ sahāyaḥ pārthānāṃ nāpi duryodhanasya vai iti me niścitā buddir vāsudevam avekṣya ha
english: I shall not be the ally of the Pārthas, nor indeed of Duryodhana — this is my firm resolve, having weighed Vāsudeva's decision.

sanskrit: jāto 'si bhārate vaṃśe sarvapārthivapūjite gaccha yudhyasva dharmeṇa kṣātreṇa bharatarṣabha
english: You are born in the Bhārata lineage, honoured by all kings; go, fight in accordance with the warrior's dharma, O bull of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: ity evam uktaḥ sa tadā pariṣvajya halāyudham kṛṣṇaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ jñātvā yuddhān mene jitaṃ jayam
english: Thus addressed, Duryodhana then embraced the wielder of the plough; and knowing that Kṛṣṇa had been secured away from the battle, he reckoned the victory already won.

sanskrit: so 'bhyayāt kṛtavarmāṇaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasuto nṛpaḥ kṛtavarmā dadau tasya senām akṣauhiṇīṃ tadā
english: The king, son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, then approached Kṛtavarman, and Kṛtavarman gave him at that time a full akṣauhiṇī division of the army.

sanskrit: sa tena sarvasainyena bhīmena kurunandanaḥ vṛtaḥ pratiyayau hṛṣṭaḥ suhṛdaḥ saṃpraharṣayan
english: Escorted by that formidable combined army, the delight of the Kurus returned joyfully, gladdening the hearts of his friends.

sanskrit: gate duryodhane kṛṣṇaḥ kirīṭinam athābravīt ayudhyamānaḥ kāṃ buddhim āsthāyāhaṃ tvayā vṛtaḥ
english: When Duryodhana had gone, Kṛṣṇa then spoke to the diademed Arjuna: I who shall not fight in the battle — on what reasoning have you chosen me?

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca bhavān samarthas tān sarvān nihantuṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ nihantum aham apy ekaḥ samarthaḥ puruṣottama
english: Arjuna said: You are capable of slaying all of them — of this there is no doubt; and I too am capable of slaying them alone, O highest of men.

sanskrit: bhavāṃs tu kīrtimāṃl loke tad yaśas tvāṃ gamiṣyati yaśasā cāham apy arthī tasmād asi mayā vṛtaḥ
english: But you are celebrated in the world, and that glory will go to you; and I too am a seeker of fame — therefore you have been chosen by me.

sanskrit: sārathyaṃ tu tvayā kāryam iti me mānasaṃ sadā cirarātrepsitaṃ kāmaṃ tad bhavān kartum arhati
english: And it has always been my heart's desire that you should act as my charioteer — that long-cherished wish, O noble one, it is fitting that you fulfil.

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca upapannam idaṃ pārtha yat spardhethā mayā saha sārathyaṃ te kariṣyāmi kāmaḥ saṃpadyatāṃ tava
english: Vāsudeva said: This is fitting, O Pārtha, that you would vie with me in this way; I shall be your charioteer — let your desire be fulfilled.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evaṃ pramuditaḥ pārthaḥ kṛṣṇena sahitas tadā vṛto dāśārhapravaraiḥ punar āyād yudhiṣṭhiram
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus gladdened, Pārtha, accompanied by Kṛṣṇa and escorted by the foremost of the Dāśārhas, then returned to Yudhiṣṭhira.
